SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q5. Match Column-I with Column-II and choose the correct option:  
 
 
 

Column-I (Category) 
Column-II (Example) 
a. Public Sector 
i. TISCO 
b. Private Sector 
ii. BHEL 
c. Joint Sector 
iii. Oil India Ltd 
d. Cooperative Sector 
iv. Sugar Industry in Maharashtra 
 
Options:  
(A) a-ii, b-i, c-iv, d-iii  
(B) a-ii, b-i, c-iii, d-iv  
(C) a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv  
(D) a-iv, b-iii, c-ii, d-i

Answer / Solution:
Match Column-I with Column-II and choose the correct option: 
(B) a-ii, b-i, c-iii, d-iv 
a. Public Sector -> ii. BHEL 
b. Private Sector -> i. TISCO 
c. Joint Sector -> iii. Oil India Ltd 
d. Cooperative Sector -> iv. Sugar Industry in Maharashtra
